title: Canonical immutable SBOM package and repository subject locators
observed_behavior: SBOM ContextVM generate/import requests could resolve artifact subjects from Artifact.ImageDigest and deployment subjects from DeploymentIntent.DesiredHash, but package and repository subjects without subject.digest were rejected because only generic SBOMSubject fields were available.
intended_behavior: ContextVM sbom/generate and sbom/import requests can carry canonical immutable subjectLocator fields for package artifacts and repositories. Package locators identify a package artifact by repository UUID, namespace, package name, version, filename, and SHA-256. Repository locators identify either a git commit object id or an immutable content digest. Bahia resolves and validates these before generating/importing, without inferring mutable names as durable subject identity.
out_of_scope: automatic repository cloning or package artifact fetching beyond existing source locator handling
